record.question: A nurse is caring for a neonate with suspected Meconium Aspiration Syndrome (MAS). What is the priority nursing action for this patient?
options: Administer supplemental oxygen to correct hypoxemia
Initiate continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) to improve ventilation
Suction the pharynx and trachea immediately after birth
Administer broad-spectrum antibiotics to treat potential infection
record.explanation: Answer A: Administer supplemental oxygen to correct hypoxemia. For a newborn with meconium aspiration and hypoxemia, provide oxygen/respiratory support as indicated. Current neonatal resuscitation guidance does not recommend routine suctioning solely for meconium in a vigorous infant. Source/context note: Suction only if airway obstruction interferes with ventilation; support is based on the infant’s condition. Reference: https://www.aap.org/en/patient-care/neonatal-resuscitation-program/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
